seo.title: Contact | Legal Dispute Help
seo.description: Legal Dispute Help: call 845-299-9888, or visit 90 North Street, Suite 206, Middletown, NY 10940. Free initial assessment, Chinese throughout.

emergency.message: If you have received court papers, an eviction notice, or any letter with a stated response deadline, please say so when you call — these usually need an attorney quickly, and we will prioritise connecting you with a partner firm. Missing a response deadline is often worse than the underlying dispute.
